## Start with identity

`workspace.yaml` describes the project, implementation repositories, relationships, workspace repository, and any borrowed knowledge. `members.yaml` describes the shared roster and record language or tone.

## Keep the work traceable

Intent and plan files preserve the approved outcome and implementation approach. The permanent ID ledger prevents reuse even after archival. Knowledge notes capture the durable result rather than task history.

## Resolve local state

`repositories.local.yaml` binds logical IDs to checkout paths and base branches. `member.local.yaml` selects the active member. Native role files, worktree associations, locks, and ignored runtime files belong to the machine.

Use the [configuration reference](/docs/reference/workspace-files) for file-level ownership and [record reference](/docs/reference/records) for frontmatter fields.
